{{Quote|The Lady put up quite a struggle, youngster... a nerve pinch was necessary to quiet her.|Skorr to Luke Skywalker, having used a nerve pinch on Leia Organa|<ref name="The Bounty Hunter of Ord Mantell">"[[The Bounty Hunter of Ord Mantell]]"</ref>}}
A '''nerve pinch''' was an unarmed combat technique whose purpose was to render opponents unconscious. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Skorr/Legends|Skorr]] used it successfully on [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. During the [[Gorog]] assassination attempt on [[Tenel Ka Djo|Tenel Ka]] and her daughter [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana]], [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] also used a nerve pinch to subdue a panicked [[Ben Skywalker]].
